//: Local development overrides that are NOT configuration a developer sets per machine.
Everything that is — the encryption and signing keys, the setup token, the database and the
agent socket — lives in `.env` at the repository root, which `source scripts/dev` exports.
That file is git-ignored and created from `.env.example` on first use, so a value a developer
changes is never a tracked file they have to remember not to commit, and there is exactly one
place to look when a setting is not what they expected.
What remains here is behaviour nobody overrides individually: log levels, and a shorter agent
probe timeout because no agent runs locally and the health endpoint should say so promptly.
